dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 23, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Padres Fall to Braves in Thrilling Finish**

In a back-and-forth matchup, the Atlanta Braves edged out the San Diego Padres 6-5. Chris Sale dominated on the mound for the Braves, striking out 11 batters over six innings. On the other side, Manny Machado and Ty France led the Padres' offense, with France hitting his 16th home run of the season. Meanwhile, Dominic Smith powered the Padres with a three-RBI, three-hit performance that included a crucial home run.

The Minnesota Twins secured a 3-1 win over the Cleveland Guardians, thanks in part to Taylor Rogers' shutdown performance. Patrick Bailey's solo home run and Gavin Williams' 11 strikeouts over seven innings helped the Twins secure the victory.

The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Tampa Bay Rays 3-1, with Vladimir Guerrero Jr. and George Springer leading the charge. Shane Bieber earned the win in relief, while Ian Seymour put up a strong effort for the Rays.

In the Arizona Diamondbacks' 10-6 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, Tyler Locklear hit a three-hit, three-RBI performance, including a home run. The Diamondbacks' staff effort led to the win.

Finally, the Detroit Tigers outlasted the Kansas City Royals 4-3, with James Outman's three-RBI home run and Drew Anderson's winning performance on the mound securing the win.
